science.qualification: Color of a black body at the dayside brightness temperature 1,815 K measured in secondary eclipse at 3.6 µm (Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)), uniform over the disc and lit by its star so the day side faces it. The planet is unresolved: no map is implied, and reflected starlight is not included. Its black-body color lies outside the sRGB gamut and is shown mixed with 1% white, the least that brings it inside, hue kept.

science.description: Brightness temperature at 4.5 µm from the paper's phase-curve fit, turned into a map of longitude. It has no north-south information.
